Each 2.x flag (--only --selector-attribute --selector-class --light-class --dark-value --light-value --default-scheme --media-fallback) exits 1 naming --selector. Reading the manifest's extra field is v3-sk-4's lint verb. 5) src/lint/generated/zone-a.ts is generated from the token table (brand brand-fill on-brand good warn bad info destructive ring line chart-N seq-N, each -tint) plus deniedCurrent (bg border ring outline divide from via to; fill stroke text stay allowed); no rule reads it here (v3-gr-2 does).
